Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
When Delaying Tactics is played and the vote-calling player
has (before returning the vote card to her hand) six cards
in hand (due to having played, for example, a Bewitching
Oration), what happens?

The Bewitching is "counting against handsize" until the end
of the referendum [6.3.2]. The Delaying Tactics ends the
referendum and puts the vote card back in the calling Meth's
hand. Does the "count against handsize" effect end first,
causing the Meth to draw up to 7, then put the vote card in
hand, then discard down to 7, or does the Delaying Tactics
effect go first, causing the Meth to discard down to 6,
then draw up to 7, or do they happen simultaneously, with
no drawing/discarding necessary? Or is it the acting Meth's
choice as to how to order the effects?

Thanks,

Josh

timed out

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Cards played during a referendum are replaced after the referendum.

So she either discards back down to 6 while still waiting to replace
the card played during the referendum and then replaces the card
played during the referendum (by drawing from her library) or
replaces the card and then discards down to 7.
